title: Testing & Debugging - Quiz
description: Test your understanding of testing and debugging concepts in PEGA

questions.question: What is the primary goal of unit testing in PEGA applications?
options: To validate individual components and functions work correctly
questions.explanation: Unit testing validates individual components and functions work correctly in isolation, ensuring each part of the application behaves as expected.

questions.question: When should you implement integration testing?
options: To validate interactions between different components and systems
questions.explanation: Integration testing validates interactions between different components and systems, ensuring they work together correctly and data flows properly.

questions.question: How do you effectively debug PEGA applications?
options: Through systematic debugging tools, logs, and step-by-step analysis
questions.explanation: Effective debugging uses systematic debugging tools, comprehensive logging, step-by-step analysis, and proper error handling to identify and resolve issues.

questions.question: What is the benefit of automated testing frameworks?
options: They provide consistent, repeatable testing and early issue detection
questions.explanation: Automated testing frameworks provide consistent, repeatable testing with early issue detection, improving quality and reducing manual testing effort.

questions.question: When should you use test data management?
options: To provide consistent, realistic test data for comprehensive testing
questions.explanation: Test data management provides consistent, realistic test data for comprehensive testing, ensuring tests are meaningful and cover various scenarios.

questions.question: How do you handle regression testing?
options: Through comprehensive test suites that verify existing functionality after changes
questions.explanation: Regression testing uses comprehensive test suites to verify existing functionality remains intact after changes, preventing unintended side effects.

questions.question: What is crucial for performance testing?
options: Load testing, stress testing, and performance benchmarking
questions.explanation: Performance testing requires load testing, stress testing, and performance benchmarking to ensure applications can handle expected user loads.

questions.question: How should you document test cases and results?
options: Through comprehensive documentation with clear test scenarios and expected results
questions.explanation: Test cases and results should be documented comprehensively with clear test scenarios, expected results, actual outcomes, and detailed explanations.
